name: Execution duration
description: Elapsed time between two human-reviewed events
calculation_definition: t_end - t_start using canonical decoded-frame timing
required_roles: Human-confirmed attempt; roles only if the selected event definition requires them
required_tracking_continuity: Required only when role-dependent events are used
timing_requirements: Known physical time scale and confirmed attempt boundaries
abstention_conditions: Unknown time scale; invalid manifest; unconfirmed event boundaries; non-comparable phase schema

name: Technical-event sequence
description: Ordered phase/event labels under a declared schema
body_or_relationship_target: Both athletes and complete selected action
calculation_definition: Versioned event boundaries plus an explicit native/expert-mapped/unmapped relationship
camera_requirements: View and coverage sufficient for every declared event
reference_availability: No direct approved source mapping among current five-source evidence set
abstention_conditions: Unvalidated event detector; unmapped schema; role or continuity uncertainty

name: Projected trunk inclination
description: Image-plane trunk-axis angle relative to image vertical
event_or_phase_dependency: Declared source phase/event or human-selected review frame
calculation_definition: atan2 of declared projected trunk vector relative to image vertical
required_landmarks: Bilateral shoulders and hips or validated trunk-axis subset
required_tracking_continuity: Stable selected Tori evidence for the reported instant/interval
camera_requirements: Near-planar suitable view and low camera roll
normalization: None beyond declared image coordinate convention
abstention_conditions: Missing landmarks; unsuitable view; role uncertainty; boundary-normalized-only visibility; invalid timing

name: Projected support-leg knee angle
description: Image-plane hip-knee-ankle angle for the human-confirmed support leg
event_or_phase_dependency: Declared entry/Kake event or human-selected review frame
required_tracking_continuity: Stable selected Tori evidence for the reported instant/interval
camera_requirements: Suitable view with low out-of-plane risk
abstention_conditions: Missing landmarks; unconfirmed support leg; unsuitable view; identity uncertainty

name: Projected attacking-leg knee angle
description: Image-plane hip-knee-ankle angle for the human-confirmed attacking leg
event_or_phase_dependency: Declared entry/Kake event or human-selected review frame
required_tracking_continuity: Stable selected Tori evidence for the reported instant/interval
camera_requirements: Suitable view with low out-of-plane risk
abstention_conditions: Missing landmarks; unconfirmed attacking leg; unsuitable view; identity uncertainty

name: Projected attacking-leg hip angle
description: Future image-plane attacking-leg hip/segment angle with definition unresolved
required_landmarks: Trunk/pelvis proxy;attacking hip;attacking knee;exact axis unresolved
camera_requirements: Suitable view and exact segment-axis convention required
abstention_conditions: Always abstain until proximal reference;axis;angle convention;valid range;view and normalization are approved

name: Projected Hikite/Tsurite configuration
description: Projected shoulder-elbow-wrist configuration; grip meaning remains a hypothesis
calculation_definition: Projected joint angles and wrist/hand displacement under a future approved method
camera_requirements: View must expose upper limbs; occlusion risk explicit
abstention_conditions: Role uncertainty; occlusion; no grip-contact evidence; method not validated

name: Projected attacking-foot elevation
description: Image-plane vertical displacement of attacking foot
calculation_definition: Vertical image displacement normalized only to a declared stable reference
required_landmarks: Attacking ankle;heel or foot point;declared reference
normalization: Stable body or mat reference when available
abstention_conditions: Camera motion; missing reference; role/leg uncertainty; depth motion

name: Projected hip knee foot displacement
description: Image-plane path of declared lower-limb points
calculation_definition: 2D path or axis displacement under a declared coordinate convention
required_roles: Human-confirmed Tori and leg as applicable
camera_requirements: Fixed camera and out-of-plane risk stated
normalization: Declared stable body-length reference when used
abstention_conditions: Camera motion; occlusion; identity uncertainty; incompatible scale/setup

name: Projected angular velocity
description: Image-plane rate of a declared joint or segment angle
calculation_definition: Future approved derivative of a filtered projected-angle series
required_landmarks: Landmarks required by the underlying projected angle
timing_requirements: Validated frame timestamps and adequate temporal density
abstention_conditions: Insufficient temporal density; unvalidated smoothing; timestamp or identity uncertainty

name: Projected linear velocity
description: Image-plane rate of a declared landmark trajectory
body_or_relationship_target: Human-confirmed Tori or Uke declared point
units: pixels per second or normalized body-length per second
calculation_definition: Future approved derivative of a filtered 2D path
timing_requirements: Validated frame timestamps and adequate temporal density
abstention_conditions: Insufficient temporal density; camera motion; depth motion; identity uncertainty

name: Projected base-of-support proxy
description: Image-plane foot placement and inter-foot relation; not physical stability
calculation_definition: Projected inter-foot distance and support-foot position under a declared convention
required_landmarks: Both ankles;heels or foot points;mat plane if visible
abstention_conditions: Foot occlusion; unconfirmed support leg; identity uncertainty; unsuitable view

name: Projected Tori/Uke relative position
description: Image-plane relative vectors or distances between declared body proxies
calculation_definition: Image-plane relative geometry normalized only to a declared reference
required_landmarks: Declared pelvis;trunk;foot proxies for both athletes
abstention_conditions: Either role uncertain; overlap/occlusion; missing landmarks; unvalidated scale

name: 2D COM proxy
description: Projected model-based whole-body proxy; never true 3D COM
calculation_definition: Future weighted projected segment proxy using a disclosed anthropometric model
camera_requirements: Whole body sufficiently visible; suitable view
abstention_conditions: Incomplete body; unknown model applicability; identity uncertainty; depth/out-of-plane motion

name: Uke projected balance displacement
description: Projected COM-proxy/foot-span relation; not measured balance
event_or_phase_dependency: Declared Kuzushi/Turning interval under explicit schema
calculation_definition: Future projected COM-proxy displacement relative to projected foot span
camera_requirements: Suitable view of Uke and feet
abstention_conditions: Uke role or track uncertain; foot/whole-body occlusion; unvalidated phase mapping
